import sys, platform, json, os, importlib.util, hashlib, contextlib, io
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pytest
wt=Path.cwd()
records=[]
for name,path in [
 ("pr451_completion_import_probe","tests/common/test_mes_krylov_completion.py"),
 ("pr451_stable_import_probe","tests/common/test_mes_krylov_stable_decoder.py")]:
 spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,wt/path)
 test=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
 spec.loader.exec_module(test)
 mod=test.MOD
 records.append({"test_file":str(Path(test.__file__).resolve()),"module_name":mod.__name__,
  "module_file":str(Path(mod.__file__).resolve()),"module_spec_origin":mod.__spec__.origin,
  "module_sha256":hashlib.sha256(Path(mod.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
  "STF3_basis_dtype":str(mod._STF3_BASIS.dtype),
  "OrbitChartUnavailable_inherits_OrbitInputError":issubclass(mod.OrbitChartUnavailable,mod.OrbitInputError)})
config=io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(config):np.show_config()
runtime=io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(runtime):np.show_runtime()
print(json.dumps({
 "implementation":platform.python_implementation(),"python":platform.python_version(),
 "executable":sys.executable,"real_executable":str(Path(sys.executable).resolve()),
 "prefix":sys.prefix,"base_prefix":sys.base_prefix,"platform":platform.platform(),
 "machine":platform.machine(),"byteorder":sys.byteorder,
 "numpy":np.__version__,"numpy_path":np.__file__,"pytest":pytest.__version__,"pytest_path":pytest.__file__,
 "float64":{"dtype":str(np.dtype(np.float64)),"bits":np.finfo(np.float64).bits,"eps":np.finfo(np.float64).eps},
 "numpy_show_config":config.getvalue(),"numpy_show_runtime":runtime.getvalue(),
 "import_records":records,"sys_path":sys.path,
 "probe_scope":"Imports the exact existing two test loaders and records MOD paths/dtype. No test functions, decoder call, stress or basis identity assertion executed by this probe."
},indent=2))
